fact: SNDI held a 40-day digital-skills course (computing, Internet, AI, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) from 22 June to 29 July 2026 in Katiola for 192 civil servants and state agents from about thirty public bodies in the Hambol region, funded from the digital ministry's budget line.
Fraternite Matin reports that with this 13th edition SNDI has brought the number of civil servants trained since the programme launched to more than 37,500.
